result:
All fourteen queries ran and gave sensible answers on the sample files. Three things you may want to know about how they work:

- **Rounding (H2, H10):** qlang has no round verb. I add 0.5, cut off the decimals through `print`, `split "."` and `parseJson`, then divide back. That is correct for the positive numbers here.
- **Raw-text queries (H8–H11):** these were run as `qlang --raw '<query>' < file`, so they need `--raw` for the same input.
- **H14:** it strips only `; . , !` as punctuation, which is enough for the given sentence but not a general letters-only split.

Results: H1 gives Alice, Gita and Zed. H2 gives 69.23. H5 gives 102, 104 and 106. H14 gives dog 3, the 3, a 2.

H1: filter ~(at :active | eq true) | filter ~(/country | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(at :age | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gte 30) ~(false)) * /name | sort
H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * (/items * (:q /qty :p /price | q | mul p)) | flat | flat | sum | mul 100 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parseJson | div 100
H3: groupBy ~(/customer | lower) * count
H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys * keyword | sort)}
H5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id
H6: * (at :labels | if (type | eq ::vec) ~(/) ~([])) | flat * lower | distinct | sort
H7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (type | eq ::map) ~(/login) ~("unassigned")) * count
H8: lines * (split " ") | filter ~(count | gt 3) | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
H9: lines * (split " ") | filter ~(count | gt 3) | filter ~(/1 | if (eq "ERROR") ~(true) ~(eq "WARN")) * (drop 3 | filter ~(startsWith "user=")) | flat * (split "=" | /1) | distinct | sort
H10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(split "," | count | gt 4) * (split ",") | filter ~(/4 | lower | eq "up") | filter ~(/2 | eq "" | not) | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | :c count | sum | div c | mul 10 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parseJson | div 10)
H11: lines | filter ~(eq "" | not) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "=" | {:k (/0) :v (drop 1 | join "=")}) | filter ~(/k | lower | startsWith "db_") * {:k (/k | split "_" | drop 1 | join "_" | lower) :v /v} | indexBy ~(/k) * /v
H12: :d /defaults/timeout | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | sort ~(/name) * {:name /name :timeout (at :timeout | if (type | eq ::number) ~(/) ~(d)) :team (at :owner | if (type | eq ::map) ~(at :team | if (type | eq ::string) ~(/) ~("none")) ~("none"))}
H13: /results | filter ~(at :score | if (type | eq ::number) ~(gte 50) ~(false)) | sort ~(/score) | reverse * (:t (at :tags | if (type | eq ::vec) ~(/) ~([])) | [/profile/first /profile/last] | join " " | append ": " | append (t | join "|"))
H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | lower | split ";" | join " " | split "." | join " " | split "," | join " " | split "!" | join " " | split " " | filter ~(eq "" | not) | :ws / | distinct * (:x / | {:word x :count (ws | filter ~(eq x) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
